Constrictor.description: Possessing a muscular tail suited for gripping and tripping opponents.

features.name: Constrictor Lizardfolk
features.tldr: Your tail assists in grappling maneuvers and maintaining physical balance.

Sandstrider.description: Adapted to scorching deserts and loose sand dunes.

features.name: Sandstrider Lizardfolk
features.tldr: You gain resistance to heat and move easily across loose terrain.
